name: fmp_income_statement
description:
Income statements for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/income-statement): revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, EBITDA, net income, EPS, one record per period.
Returns {symbol, period, statements}: statements is the list of FMP period records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), period (annual or quarter; default annual), limit (integer 1-100, number of periods; default 5).
Sibling statements: fmp_balance_sheet and fmp_cash_flow; ratios: fmp_key_metrics; growth rates: fmp_financial_growth; forecasts: fmp_analyst_estimates.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "quarter", "limit": 4}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
